articles.title: Odisha Cabinet Approves Free Campus Wi-Fi, New Paddy Procurement Policy, and Water Storage Projects
articles.description: The Odisha State Cabinet, chaired by Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi, convened at Lok Seva Bhawan on November 9, 2026, approving 13 key proposals spanning 10 government departments. Among the decisions are major policy initiatives in higher education, agriculture procurement, public distribution, and water resources management. articles.title: Why selection on the basis of religion in army training? Questions raised on Karnataka government's plan
articles.description: Controversy has arisen over the issue of tender for giving 60 days of military training only to minority students under the Karnataka government's plan for 2026-27. Questions are being raised that why selection on religious basis in subjects like national defence, discipline and patriotism? Shouldn't youth from all communities get equal opportunities in such government-funded training programs? The debate on eligibility, constitutional validity and transparency of the scheme has intensified.
